maddeler.e:
ننفقئ (form VII)
# نَنْفَقِئُ (nanfaqiʔu) /nan.fa.qi.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
# نَنْفَقِئَ (nanfaqiʔa) /nan.fa.qi.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
# نَنْفَقِئْ (nanfaqiʔ) /nan.fa.qiʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَقَأَ (infaqaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
